content.text:
I reviewed flag 1 against the draft as a whole.

**Flag 1 — C9 (philosophy paragraph):** The quoted sentence is a statement of investment thesis, and the draft does not leave it standing alone. The same document carries a dedicated **Key Risks** section that addresses precisely the risks the flag names — concentration (25–35 holdings, single-name setbacks), style (quality growth can lag for extended periods, with the actual 12-month shortfall quantified at 2.90 pp net), sector (overweights/underweights vs. the Index named), valuation (premium multiples can contract even when results are sound), and market (fully invested, clients can lose a substantial portion of principal). The performance section also affirmatively discloses the trailing-12-month underperformance and cross-references the risk discussion. That is fair and balanced treatment of the benefits described; C9 is satisfied on the face of the document.

Note also that the flag's quoted text is not the same text as either unmatched known issue: the gross-only "Highlights" bullet (p1, C2) and the "outperformed the Index over every trailing period ... in rising and falling markets alike" claim (p2, C6) are distinct sentences, the latter merely sitting in the same paragraph. The flag does not reach either one, so it cannot be treated as matching them.
